svg.title: cwtrain hot-load flow
svg.desc: One training step: the trainer's weight sync writes a full checkpoint or a delta, the cwtrain hook or synchronizer uploads it to AI Object Storage, creates a hot-load and polls until every replica is READY; the deployment's replicas load the snapshot and the next rollout batch samples the new weights from its OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
